# Dinner party Saturday

Eight guests on Saturday evening. Maria Lopez is bringing her sister, Tom Becker will arrive late from the station. Menu: roasted squash soup, a slow braise with polenta, then a pear tart. I want the soup and the tart done before anyone arrives so that I can sit with them.

Shopping on Friday at the market. Wine from the cellar, two whites and one red. A table for eight needs the extra chairs from the attic and the long cloth. One guest does not eat pork. See [[Mise en place]] for the routine and [[Ratatouille]] as a backup side dish.
